info.title: Transit API
info.description:
Public, read-only transit routing API for Japan.

All times are seconds from the service-date midnight in the result's timezone;
values may exceed 86400 (after-midnight service) or be negative (yesterday's
service still running) — format for display client-side. Ids are feed-qualified
("feedId:localId"). Geographic endpoints accept "geo:<lat>,<lon>".

bbox.description: Stop extent; used to pick feeds for geographic queries.

serviceStart.description: Earliest service date the feed's timetable describes (YYYYMMDD).

serviceEnd.description: Latest service date the feed's timetable describes (YYYYMMDD); the data's 'as of' date.

stale.description: True when serviceEnd is before the request date: the timetable is a past snapshot kept usable via a forward roll.

items.description: One ingested feed, with its license attribution.

lat.description: Station coordinates, carried so map/guidance callers skip feed loads.

kind.description: Rail-like station vs roadside stop, by serving mode.

accessWalkSecs.description: Walk from the geographic origin to the first stop (geo queries only).

egressWalkSecs.description: Walk from the last stop to the geographic destination (geo queries only).

headwayBased.description: True when times are worst-case bounds from headway operation.

transitModes.description: Transit modes actually used from this feed in returned options, when known.

serviceEnd.description: Latest service date this feed's timetable describes (YYYYMMDD); present when known.

stale.description: True when this feed's data ended before the query date and was rolled forward to stay usable.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp the registry was generated.

name.description: Official name, e.g. "京浜急行電鉄".

mark.description: Short monogram shown when no licensed logo asset exists, e.g. "KK".

brandColor.description: Corporate brand color (hex, "#rrggbb"); absent when no single authoritative color is known.

feedIds.description: Feeds whose legs belong to this operator (the feedId prefix of their ids).

dataLicense.description: Data license shared by this operator's feeds (e.g. "CC BY 4.0").

dataAttribution.description: Required data attribution, when the source mandates one.

termsUrl.description: Usage-terms / permission page (e.g. an ODPT operator data page).

asset.description: Asset path served under the operator-logo base (operators/logos/...).

license.description: License of the logo asset itself (e.g. "Public domain", "CC BY-SA 4.0").

attribution.description: Required credit line for the asset.

logo.description: Present only when a license-cleared logo asset has been acquired.
